summary: Build localization tools, partner scorecards, and action plans in this 5-day course. Strengthen local ownership and donor reporting.
lede: Localization and local partner capacity strengthening helps professionals working with local partners assess capacity and improve shared delivery. Participants practice partner diagnostics, capacity-strengthening planning, governance mapping, and performance tracking, using localization indicators and reporting tools to build a practical roadmap and brief decision-makers on progress.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with local partners and need a practical, structured way to assess capacity, strengthen delivery systems, and report progress. Localization leads managing partner transition and local ownership plans. Partnership managers coordinating sub-awards, roles, and shared delivery. Program officers working with local NGOs and community-based organizations. MEAL specialists tracking localization indicators and partner performance. Consortium coordinators aligning multiple local and international implementers. Capacity strengthening officers designing coaching and institutional support. Grant managers monitoring partner compliance and evidence requirements. Humanitarian response coordinators working on local implementation handover. Health program managers supporting district and local service delivery. Education and livelihoods project leads building local delivery capability.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, a real or realistic partner case, and familiarity with basic program or donor reporting documents. Templates used in class will assume you can read simple budgets, workplans, and performance reports, but no coding or advanced analytics software is required.
